unlisted_practices: Local deployment of fine-tuned open-source LLM to keep patient data on-premises for privacy-preserving report structuring
Using commercial LLM pseudo-labels to fine-tune a local model for structured report extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates the retrospective extraction accuracy and JSON formatting fidelity of a locally fine-tuned open-source LLM for structuring mammography reports compared to commercial API models, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
